10_realistic_daily_combo

Mandy Cheung

2025-09-05

This script creates realistic background conditions, including thermal history and physical environmental conditions of the 3806 reefs of the GBR.

Create 20-days mean

First compile the daily mean of the variables for each reef. This part was done only for variables with daily values (including DHW, current, cloud, and secchi depth). Other thermal history variables were summarized at a yearly level, so not needed for this step.

# mean reef level per day
DHWs_yearly<-list()
for (y in 1:length(DHW_yearly)) {
  df<-DHW_yearly[[y]] %>% group_by(ID) %>% 
    summarise (across(everything(), mean, na.rm=TRUE))
  DHWs_yearly[[y]] <- df
}

current_yearly<-list()
for (y in 1:length(curr_yearly)){
  df<-curr_yearly[[y]] %>% group_by(ID) %>%
    summarise (across(everything(), mean, na.rm=TRUE))
  current_yearly[[y]]<-df
}

cloud_yearly <- list()
for (y in 1:length(clouds_yearly)) {
  df <- sapply(clouds_yearly[[y]], function(df) {
  tapply(df$layer, df$ID, mean, na.rm = TRUE)
  }) %>% data.frame()
  colnames(df)<-names(clouds_yearly[[y]])
  cloud_yearly[[y]]<-cbind(1:3806, df)
}

secc_yearly <- list()
for (y in 1:length(secchi_yearly)) {
  secc_year=gbr_rf_all[,c("rowid","LABEL_ID")]
  secc_year <- secc_year %>% st_drop_geometry()
  colnames(secc_year)[1:2]<-c("ID","LABEL_ID")
  for (i in 1:length(secchi_yearly[[y]][[1]])){
    if (i<=91){
  df<-secchi_yearly[[y]][[1]][[i]] %>% data.frame() #%>%

  df<-rowid_to_column(df)
  df<-left_join(df,gbr_spg,by="rowid")
  df<-df%>%na.omit()
  df$ID <- as.integer(df$ID)
  df <- df %>% group_by(ID,LABEL_id) %>% summarise(mean=mean(value, na.rm=TRUE)) 
  colnames(df)[2]<-"LABEL_ID"
  secc_year<-left_join(secc_year,df, by =c("ID","LABEL_ID"))
  colnames(secc_year)[ncol(secc_year)]<-names(secchi_yearly[[y]][[1]][i])
    }
    }
   secc_yearly[[y]]<-secc_year
}

list_of_pred<-list(DHWs_yearly,current_yearly,secc_yearly,cloud_yearly)

save(list_of_pred, DHWs_yearly, current_yearly, secc_yearly, cloud_yearly, 
     file="./memory/10_list_of_pred_3806.RData")

Set random seed and select 20 random start dates. For each year, we randomly selected 30 start dates and calculated the mean value of each variable over the subsequent 20-day period. This allows us to generate 390 realistic combinations of scenarios (13 years x 30 combo).

Because some variables have lots of missing dates, e.g. clouds, in 2019 only 5 dates in March has data. First create a master full date list, to get indices of all dates in all list:

list_of_pred<-list(DHWs_yearly,current_yearly,secc_yearly,cloud_yearly)

So that the date range covers more dates. This reduces the number of combo from the initial 50 to 30.

combo_values <- list()   
counter <- 1

for (y in seq_along(year)) {
 ## so first for each year create a master date list
  master_dates <- names(DHWs_yearly[[y]])[-1] # because DHWs have no missing data
  curr_dates<-data.frame(date=names(current_yearly[[y]])[-1])
  secc_dates<-data.frame(date=names(secc_yearly[[y]])[-1])
  cloud_dates<-data.frame(date=names(cloud_yearly[[y]])[-1])
  master_dates <- data.frame(ID=1:length(master_dates),
                             date=master_dates)
  curr_dates <-curr_dates %>% left_join(., master_dates, by="date") 
  secc_dates <- secc_dates %>%  left_join(.,master_dates, by="date")  
  cloud_dates <- cloud_dates%>%  left_join(.,master_dates, by="date")

  master_dates<-list(master_dates, curr_dates, secc_dates, cloud_dates)
  
  # find the minimum index
  lens <- sapply (list_of_pred, function(x) length(x[[y]]))
  which_min<-which.min(lens)
  
  # create the 30 random start dates, no repeats
  set.seed(random_seed[[y]])
  start_dates <- sample(
    1:((length(list_of_pred[[which_min]][[y]])-1) - 20),
    30,
    replace = FALSE
  )
  
  # looping through the start dates
  for (i in seq_along(start_dates)) {
    # get the indices of the dates
    ind <- start_dates[i]:(start_dates[i] + 19)
    # calculate the row means for each predictor
    mean_values <- lapply(seq_along(list_of_pred), function(pred_i) {
    
      df <- list_of_pred[[pred_i]][[y]]
      
      # Ensure ID column exists
      colnames(df)[1] <- "ID"
      date_ind <- master_dates[[pred_i]] %>% filter(ID %in% (ind)) %>% 
        dplyr::select(date) %>%as.vector()
      # # Add missing columns 
      missing_cols <- setdiff(date_ind$date, colnames(df))
      if (length(missing_cols) > 0) {
        for (col in missing_cols) {
          df[[col]] <- NA
        }
      }
      
      # Subset and enforce numeric
      sub_df <- df[, c("ID",date_ind$date)]
      sub_df <- as.data.frame(lapply(sub_df, as.numeric))
      if (anyNA(sub_df)==TRUE){
        sub_df<- left_join(sub_df,rfplgn_3806[,c(8:9,26)], by=c("ID"="rowid"))
        sub_df<-sub_df%>%st_drop_geometry() # drop the polygon and make points for filling
        sub_df<-st_as_sf(sub_df, coords=c("X_COORD","Y_COORD"),crs=4326)
      # Fill NA row-wise 
        cols_name <- colnames(sub_df)[2:(ncol(sub_df)-1)]
        sub_df_filled <- fill_nearest_by_day(sub_df, cols_name)
        sub_df_filled <- sub_df_filled %>%st_drop_geometry()
        } else {sub_df_filled <- sub_df}
      # Compute row means
      row_means <- rowMeans(sub_df_filled[,2:ncol(sub_df_filled)], na.rm = TRUE)
      
      # Convert NaN (all NA rows) -> NA
      row_means[is.nan(row_means)] <- NA
      
      results <- data.frame(
        ID = df$ID,
        value = row_means
      )
      
      colnames(results)[2] <- pred_var[pred_i]
      
      return(results)
    })
    
    # Join predictors
    mean_values <- purrr::reduce(mean_values, dplyr::left_join, by = "ID")
    
    mean_values <- data.frame(
      Year = year[y],
      combo = paste0("combo", i),
      mean_values
    )
    
    combo_values[[counter]] <- mean_values
    counter <- counter + 1
    print(counter)
  }
}

# Combine at the end 
combo_values_df <- do.call(rbind, combo_values)


#save(combo_values,combo_values_df, file="./memory/10_env_variable_combo_filled.RData") #15/06/2026 - not used
save(combo_values,combo_values_df, file="./memory/10_env_variable_combo_filled_30.RData") #16/06/2026

Because thermal history data were summarized at a yearly level. These will then be static based on the year for each of the 3806 reefs.

combo_values_df<-combo_values_df%>% st_drop_geometry()

anyNA(combo_values_df)

Plot as map to check if patterns make sense

# NAs in curr, secchi, and cloud columns
combo_values_sf<-st_as_sf(combo_values_df, coords=c("lon","lat"), crs=4326)


# because these variables have a different scale, create function to plot individually and patch together
library(patchwork)

plot_sf_patchwork <- function (data, Year_val, combo_val, vars, ncol) {
  plots <- list()
  for (v in vars) {
    p <- base_map+ data %>% filter(Year==Year_val & combo==combo_val) %>%
   geom_sf(mapping=aes(colour=.data[[v]],fill=.data[[v]])) +
  scale_colour_distiller(palette = "Spectral", name=v)+
  scale_fill_distiller(palette = "Spectral", name=v)+
  coord_sf(xlim=c(141,154),ylim=c(-09,-25),expand=FALSE)+ 
  scale_x_continuous(breaks=c(142,145,148,151)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks=c(-12,-16,-20,-24)) +
  theme_bw(base_size=10)  +
      theme(legend.position="bottom")
    
    plots[[v]]<-p

  }
  wrap_plots(plots, ncol=ncol)
}

## plotting year and combo to check
plot_sf_patchwork(combo_values_sf, Year_val="2011", combo_val="combo1", 
                    vars=c("DHW","curr","secchi","cloud","winyear_sd", "histDHW_mean", "histmDHW4","yrsinceDHW4"), ncol=4)

                    vars=c("DHW","curr","secchi","cloud","winyear_sd", "histDHW_mean", "histmDHW4","yrsinceDHW4"), ncol=4)
